preconditions.description: tiles must have a length between 1 and 7 inclusive
tiles must consist of uppercase English letters

postconditions.description: the return value must be an integer

postconditions.expression: return_value == len(set(itertools.permutations(tiles, r) for r in range(1, len(tiles) + 1)))
postconditions.description: the return value must be the number of unique non-empty sequences that can be formed using the letters in tiles
